name: comp-387

frames.best_why: Popover is fully open with the Share code label, four share icons and the link field.

tagline: A share button opens social icons and a copyable link field.
summary: A Share button opens a small popover with a row of icon buttons for embed, X, Facebook and email, above a read-only link field with a copy button.
appearance: A dark rounded popover floats above a small outlined Share button. It centers a bold 'Share code' label over four square outlined icon buttons, then shows a dark read-only field with a grey URL and a copy icon inside its right edge.
behaviour: Clicking Share opens the popover. The copy icon writes the link to the clipboard and briefly swaps to a green tick while a tooltip reads 'Copy to clipboard'; clicking outside closes the popover.
demo_content: Trigger 'Share'; popover titled 'Share code' with a coss.com share link and embed, X, Facebook and email icons.
search_phrases: social share buttons in a card
share sheet with twitter and facebook
email embed and copy link options
use_when: A page needs a quick way to share or copy its link from a compact control.
avoid_when: The social buttons only render icons; none of them build a share URL or open a window in this code.
customise: The share URL is a fixed default value and the icon buttons have no handlers; making them real means editing the source. Width and colours use tokens.
weight_why: A small popover with four icons and an input; nothing runs until opened.

a11y.note: Every icon button and the copy control have aria-labels and focus rings; the copied confirmation is visual only.

issues: The social and embed buttons have no handlers; only copying the link works.
The copied confirmation is a visual tick with no live announcement.
polish_why: Neat share popover; unwired social buttons and a fixed link make it a demo.
